meta.description: Bazi charts rendered by the original FourPillars.plot / EightWords via the real luxon build

pillar.name: bath
pillar.desc: The Bath phase indicates capricious nature, with one often bouncing from one idea to the next, resulting in volatile friendship and career changes.  At the same time, one is plagued with a stubborn sense of self which can cause conflicts in relationships.

dm.name: bath
dm.desc: The Bath phase indicates capricious nature, with one often bouncing from one idea to the next, resulting in volatile friendship and career changes.  At the same time, one is plagued with a stubborn sense of self which can cause conflicts in relationships.

pillar.name: death
pillar.desc: One will be hesitant on important decisions and dwell on trivial matters.  Energy is on decline, and most find it difficult to stay in long term relationships.

dm.name: growth
dm.desc: As the first (or third, depending on interpretation) phase of the life cycle, this indicates an exception level of honesty, intelligence, and wholeness.  Excellence in creativity will help advance careers.  However, it is said that leadership position should be delayed until a later stage.

pillar.name: nourishing
pillar.desc: At this phase, one is content.  As the last (or second, depending on interpretation) phase of the life cycle, one will carefully seek opportunities to develop.

dm.name: nourishing
dm.desc: At this phase, one is content.  As the last (or second, depending on interpretation) phase of the life cycle, one will carefully seek opportunities to develop.

branch.name: wei
branch.body: spleen and pancrease, small intestine meridian

pillar.name: grave
pillar.desc: One will become a closed shell who prefers to collect memories and linger on the past.  Difficult to open to change and societal fluctuations.  Correlated to introvertedness.

dm.name: youth
dm.desc: The beginning of the ascent. One sees potential on the horizon and will thrive to achieve success.  Stubborness persists as the climb continues.

gua.personality: volatility, danger, risk, fast, hidden ability, abyss
